manufacturer.name: NABCO Entrances
manufacturer.note: US automatic pedestrian door manufacturer, formerly Gyro Tech - the GT model prefix and the "gyro tech" naming inside the older documents are from that lineage. Serves its own manuals as static PDFs from a WordPress uploads tree and keeps a literature index; both are registered as harvest targets.

documents.evidence: On nabcoentrances.com, the manufacturer's own domain. Document code C-00105 and revision 10-19-16 from the file name; 52 pages, covering the U30 microprocessor control, per the search result. Not fetched - egress blocked.

documents.title: GT1175 Standard Slide Doors Quick Set-Up and Parts Guide, Rev 8-10-16
documents.evidence: On nabcoentrances.com. Shares document code C-00105 with the installation manual above but carries a different revision, a different title (Quick Set-Up and Parts Guide) and a different length (64 pages against 52). documents.title: GT1175 Installation Manual U01, 7-22-96
documents.evidence: On nabcoentrances.com. The 1996 edition for the U01 control, kept alongside the current one because doors of that age are still in service and the newer manual does not cover the older controller. Its result title reads "gyro tech - 1175 whisper slide", which is the document's own heading. Not fetched - egress blocked.
